title: Command Palette Dock is empty on secondary monitors in multi-monitor setup
summary: The report has clear reproduction details and matches the already identified secondary-monitor blank Dock behavior in issue 49604.

judgment.rationale: The reported behavior is the same as the existing Command Palette Dock issue 49604: the Dock frame appears on a secondary display but its configured content is blank.
evidence: The reporter consistently reproduces an empty Dock on both secondary monitors while the primary monitor renders the configured items.
Per-display detection and enablement work, narrowing the failure to secondary-display Dock content rendering.
The automated triage identified issue 49604 as describing the identical blank-secondary-display behavior.
judgment.recommended_action: Link issue 49604 and consolidate the report there.

comment.body: Thanks for the detailed multi-monitor reproduction. This appears to match issue 49604, which tracks the Command Palette Dock bar appearing on a secondary display without rendering its configured contents. Please add any monitor layout, scaling, or GPU details that differ from that report there so the investigation stays consolidated.
